3D HA · outside of the house only

The house as a floating island

Make the outside of the house read as a floating island diorama like the two reference renders, touching only the exterior. Each piece is judged blind against the reference by a fresh critic, and the loop runs until the critic picks ours.

The bar

Pieces

  • Island edgebar pickedround 9
  • Void and floatbar pickedround 9
  • Plantingbar pickedround 9
  • Lawn and groundbar pickedround 9
  • Night lightingbar pickedround 9
  • Compositionbar pickedround 9

Paused after round 9. With two critics per piece and the sides balanced, the bar won every piece 2-0. Every earlier single-critic 'win' (lawn r2/r7, edge r3, planting r4, void r6) had ours in position B, and round 8 showed critics pick B 9 times in 12, so those wins were most likely position bias. Honest standing: the realtime island has not yet beaten either reference blind on any piece. The critics now agree on our gaps: low-poly spindly trees, a murky soil band with pasted-on stones, mowing bands that vanish at frame scale, a night that is too dark and cold, and trees hemming the house in.
